refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationDivide function calculates the cumulative quotient of the values passed in argv, that it, it starts with argv[0] and divides by each value from argv[1] to argv[argc-1] where argc is the number of values passed.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoOperationDivide returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the division operation. If argv[1] or any later argument is zero, the object rreturned will represent the error value SilikoErrorZeroDivision.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationDivide function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
